nodes.description: Public uint256 state variable test1 declared in NFGasNames; not referenced by any function.
Public bytes32 state variable test2 declared in NFGasNames; not referenced by any function.
Public mapping(uint256 => string) names storing NFT name registrations, written in setName.
Public IERC721 nfgas reference, the external NFT contract used for ownership checks.
Constructor(address a) that casts the provided address to IERC721 and stores it in nfgas.
Public setName(uint256 id, string memory name) that validates ownership of token id via nfgas.ownerOf and the keccak-based hash of name, then writes names[id] = name.
Caller-supplied address used as the owner/authorization check in setName (require(nfgas.ownerOf(id) == msg.sender)).
External call nfgas.ownerOf(id) executed inside setName before the names[id] state write, on an arbitrary caller-controlled IERC721 address.
Address parameter a of the constructor, used to build the nfgas IERC721 instance.
uint256 id parameter of setName; both the token id checked via ownerOf and the mapping key for names.
string memory name parameter of setName; hashed for validation and stored in the names mapping.
Local variable hashValue = uint(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(name))) % 1025, computed from name and compared against id.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter a flows into the constructor body to construct the IERC721 nfgas reference.
Constructor assigns the converted address into the nfgas state variable.
State variable nfgas is the target object of the external ownerOf call in setName.
Parameter id is passed as the argument of the external call nfgas.ownerOf(id).
msg.sender is compared with nfgas.ownerOf(id) in a require that gates execution of setName, forming an owner-based access control dependency.
The external call to nfgas.ownerOf occurs inside setName before the names[id] state write, allowing the caller-controlled NFT contract to re-enter or observe state mid-execution.
Parameter id is used as the mapping key when writing names[id] = name.
Parameter name is written into the names mapping at key id.
Parameter name is hashed with keccak256 and reduced modulo 1025 to produce the local hashValue.
Local hashValue participates in the require(hashValue == id) check that controls whether setName completes the write.
Parameter id is required to equal the keccak-derived hashValue, constraining the function's control flow.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor-only address parameter has no independent state; it collapses into the constructor's nfgas initialization.
Function-scoped uint256 parameter used solely for the owner check, the hash requirement and the names mapping key.
Function-scoped string parameter used only for hashing and for the names[id] assignment.
Temporary local derived from name and consumed only by the require(hashValue == id) validation inside setName.
